title: C: Pointer Basics
description: Learn pointer basics: declare a variable, get its address with &, and use a pointer to access and modify its value.

steps.title: Pointer Declaration and Usage
steps.description: Declare `int x = 42`, then a pointer `int *ptr = &x`. Print the value of x, the address of x, the pointer value, and the dereferenced pointer. Then use the pointer to change x to 99 and print the new value.
hints: Use `&x` to get the address of x.

verification.failureMessage: Print x's value, address, pointer value, and modify x through the pointer
